description.value: Revelstoke Lodge is a centrally located motel in Revelstoke, BC, offering standard and deluxe rooms steps from downtown amenities. It markets itself as the best-value motel in Revelstoke and provides free parking and fiber-optic Wi-Fi as standard inclusions. The property offers four room configurations with in-room microwaves and refrigerators, making it a practical base for touring cyclists passing through the Columbia Mountains corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and active with 2026 copyright, confirming the business is open. Phone, address (601 - 1st St West, Revelstoke), and email all match OSM tags exactly. The site lists room amenities in detail — notably 'Work desk with multiple USB charging ports' in every room type and 'Free high-speed fiber-optic Wi-Fi' throughout — but contains no mention of bike storage, laundry, breakfast, or any cycling-specific services.
concerns: Hot tub listed on homepage as 'Coming Spring 2026' — not yet available as of cached content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel in central Revelstoke with an active website and booking system. A practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Trans-Canada corridor.

Device charging.detail: All room types listed on the website include 'Work desk with multiple USB charging ports'
